steps.title: Hardware identity and PGOOD
steps.procedure: Read factory FPGA DNA and MCU EEPROM serial under leases. Match enrolled UID, integrated build and stable physical PGOOD.
steps.limits: MCU EEPROM serial and FPGA IDCODE are not unique factory identity. CPU factory signature not read.

steps.title: Strict ADC strobe check after SRAM restoration
steps.procedure: Probe both ADC inputs at five small differential setpoints; every STR rising-edge spacing must be4 raw capture samples. Retain a rejected buffer before analysis raises.
steps.limits: Timing guard only; a failure does not locate the cause in ADC, CPLD or FPGA sampling phase.
